heading.title: Of Offences Relating to Coin, Currency-Notes, Bank-Notes, and Government Stamps

article.title: Using as genuine, forged or counterfeit coin, Government stamp, currency-notes or bank-notes
article.content: Whoever imports or exports, or sells or delivers to, or buys or receives from, any other person, or otherwise traffics or uses as genuine, any forged or counterfeit coin, stamp, currency-note or bank-note, knowing or having reason to believe the same to be forged or counterfeit, shall be punished with imprisonment for life, or with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to ten years, and shall also be liable to fine.
article.html:
179Using as genuine, forged or counterfeit coin, Government stamp, currency-notes or bank-notes

Section 179 · Chapter X

Whoever imports or exports, or sells or delivers to, or buys or receives from, any other person, or otherwise traffics or uses as genuine, any forged or counterfeit coin, stamp, currency-note or bank-note, knowing or having reason to believe the same to be forged or counterfeit, shall be punished with imprisonment for life, or with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to ten years, and shall also be liable to fine.
